(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug >/dev/null); APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name apksigner | sort | tail -1)"; echo INSTALLED_SIGNER_SHA256=$BEFORE_SIGNER; echo NEW_SIGNER_SHA256=$NEW_SIGNER; test -n "$BEFORE_SIGNER"; test "$BEFORE_SIGNER" = "$NEW_SIGNER"; echo '--- NON-DESTRUCTIVE INSTALL -R ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" install -r "$APK"; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" logcat -c; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity; sleep 2; echo '--- AFTER ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=|lastUpdateTime=' | head -10 | tr -d '\r'; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$PID"; echo PID=$PID; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; echo '--- APP FATALS ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief '*:E' | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|chromium.*ERROR' || true; echo '--- DEVICES ---'; "$ADB" devices -l
